changelog_text: Greatly improved graphing, added ability to export telemetry data via CSV, added fuel gauges, added alert thresholds, and added the ability to save mod settings and positions.

listing.name: Kitten Engineer Redux
listing.abstract: Utility mod for KSA that mirrors KSP's Kerbal Engineer Redux.
listing.description:
Kitten Engineer Redux is a utility readout mod for Kitten Space Agency. It aims to mirror the KSP mod "Kerbal Engineer Redux" by providing the player with useful vehicle data inside of the VAB and during flight.

Dependencies:
 - [ModMenu](https://github.com/MrJeranimo/ModMenu/)
